page.overview:
What is Heatmor?

Heatmor is a large bipedal Pokémon that resembles an anteater. It has an elongated snout from which it shoots out fire like a flamethrower. Its somewhat chubby body is primarily reddish-orange, like molten magma, with a brown head, brown leggings, and long yellow strands running down its body. It also has long, yellow claws, arm bands around its wrists, and a tail that resembles a pipe.

Heatmor is based on an and a . The brown sections of its wrists also resemble s. The design of its tail may also make it based on an engine. Its relationship with Durant is based on the predator and prey relationship of anteaters and s. This is also reflected in their types, in which Durant's / type is solely weak to the type, the type that Heatmor is.

Heatmor comes from heat, armor, and mortar. Heatmor's name may also be a play on eat more, as it voraciously consumes Durant.
